finding: Original yaw signs match the earlier pivot test. Using W4 instead of paired D commands alone cannot guarantee less physical slip. All-four-positive asymmetric wheel targets are already a forward-plus-yaw mixture. Low turning speed, roller geometry, motor mismatch, surface and changing CNN output remain possible contributors.
